name: TA-5-width-clearance-wide
why: The same layout as TA-5-width-clearance-narrow, but a 2.5 m vehicle width cannot clear the 1-cell gap once the wall segments are dilated by half the width, and start/end (2 m from the gap) are far enough away that dilation does not reach them: the outcome is a genuine NO_ROUTE, not a START/END block.
